o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *yüz-. Cognate with Turkish yüzmek, Kazakh жүзу (jüzüw).
From Proto-Common Turkic *üz-. Cognate with Turkish üzmek.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish نیچون (näyçün, niçün), a contraction of نه ایچون (nä içün). By surface analysis, nə (“what”) + üçün (“for”). Equivalent to nə üçün. Cognate with Turkish niçin.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آجمق (acmaq).
Borrowed from Arabic كُلِّيَّات (kulliyyāt), plural of كُلِّيَّة (kulliyya).
